steps: Parathormone increases blood Ca2+ while Calcitonin decreases it; they are antagonistic.
Insulin decreases blood glucose while Glucagon increases it; they are antagonistic.
Aldosterone increases blood pressure (via Na+ reabsorption) while ANF decreases it (via Na+ excretion); they are antagonistic.
Relaxin relaxes pelvic ligaments during childbirth, whereas Inhibin inhibits FSH secretion; they do not have opposite effects.
Therefore, Relaxin and Inhibin are not antagonistic.
